brief: A Telegram Mini App + web portal that scores 32 instruments (28 FX pairs plus Gold, Silver, Oil and Bitcoin) for the Asian, London and New York sessions into Focus / Watch / Avoid, with the evidence shown. Audience: retail FX traders. The old mark was a generic bar-chart glyph that could belong to any finance app.

concepts.idea: Three concentric ring segments — the Asian, London and New York sessions — orbit a solid focus dot: the product's name, Session Focus Radar, drawn as one gesture.
concepts.name: Session Rings
rationale: Encodes the product itself: sessions + radar + focus, with no chart, arrow or bull cliché
Four shapes only; one colour; survives reversed and, via a heavier small-size cut, 16 px
The arcs seed a system: sweep motion, session ticks, loading states

concepts.idea: A T and a B share one stem; the T's crossbar forms the top of the B, whose bowls are true semicircles.
concepts.name: TB Monogram
rationale: Instant letter recognition; very strong at small sizes
Solid and credible — but generic: any TB company could wear it, and it tells no product story

concepts.idea: A bold candlestick centred in a broken focus ring, with a session dot in the ring's gap.
concepts.name: Target Candle
rationale: The most literal of the three; the ring and floating dot drift toward a power/location glyph

criteria: Success: ownable in a sea of blue fintech marks and chart clichés, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed, keeps the emerald identity, and seeds a wider system (motion, session graphics).
next_steps: Adopt Session Rings as the primary mark (kit delivered in frontend/shared/assets/logo/)
Swap the four app favicon.svg files for the kit's web-icons set
Outline the lockup wordmark once the type stream finalises the product font files
recommendation: Session Rings — the only concept that is the product: three session arcs around the one pair that deserves focus. It is the most distinctive in category, the simplest to reproduce (four flat shapes, one colour), and it grows into motion and interface graphics. The TB monogram is the safe fallback; the Target Candle is too literal to own.
